purpose: Re-evaluate whether the frozen Skill-Pro P1 can move from runtime-blocked to an explicitly qualified compatibility-adapted execution path without weakening provenance claims.

frozen_materialization_plan: Create a new isolated Python runtime under /data/wyt; do not mutate shared environments.
Install dependencies satisfying the pinned requirements and record exact package versions/hashes.
Create a content-addressed copy/patch changing only LocalLLM tensor_parallel_size 4 -> 1, justified by the first-party README single-GPU instruction.
Run import smoke for run.py plus TextArena Mastermind-v0 environment construction with zero outcome-bearing model calls.
Freeze local model path, tokenizer, sampling parameters, device snapshot, patch hash, and semantic-evidence manifest before authorizing P1 collection.
Label all subsequent results COMPATIBILITY_ADAPTED_AUTHOR_DOCUMENTED, never unchanged-source faithful.
